name: Beutolomäus - Täglich grüßt der Weihnachtsmann
overview: Exhausted from collecting wishes, Santa Claus Sascha takes a breather on a park bench. But the break is short-lived, as he has to go to an interview at KiKA. There, the meerkats Jan and Henry await him for a chat. When Santa Claus tries to contact Beutolomäus after the interview, something strange happens: Santa Claus suddenly finds himself back where his afternoon began – on the park bench.
